messages:
Morgan: Heads up — prod SSO alert: several customers seeing login failures + SCIM provisioning errors after KMS rotation. Error: 'SAML assertion invalid signature' + 'decrypt failed: envelope header mismatch'. Anyone on call?

Riley: I see an anomaly in audit logs — RBAC grant events show applied at 16:02 but user still lacks role. Could be decryption of role-attribute blob failing.

Jess: Can you paste the exact SAML/SCIM error snippets?

Morgan: ```
2026-03-20T16:02:11Z ERROR saml: signature verification failed: key not found: alias/rdw-idp-enc-2026-03
2026-03-20T16:02:12Z ERROR scim: decrypt failed: envelope header alg != expected (got: RSA-OAEP-256, want: RSA-OAEP)
```

Arjun: Looks like KMS key alias rotated to RSA-OAEP-256 while runtime expects RSA-OAEP — we added stricter alg checking in 2.18.0. Did private deployment customers get auto-rotated keys?

Nate: One affected tenant is on Private with our KMS integration. They rolled keys last night for compliance.

Riley: Rolling back alg check would be risky. We should add a compatibility path: accept RSA-OAEP-256 when key metadata says it's safe.

Jess: Also saw CVE-2025-XXXX in xmlsec with a signature wrapping fix. Are our saml libs patched? That could explain extra strictness.

Arjun: We patched runtime at 2.18.0 to include xmlsec 2.3.5; but private deployments may lag.

Morgan: Action items: (1) Confirm KMS alias mapping for affected tenants (Riley), (2) Add compatibility fallback to runtime 2.18.1 (Arjun), (3) Ask customer to re-upload IdP cert if rotated (Nate), (4) Run audit re-ingest for RBAC grant events (Jess).

Riley: Ran query: `SELECT tenant, key_alias FROM idp_kms_mappings WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-19'`; got tenant: acme-corp -> alias/rdw-idp-enc-2026-03. I'll DM tenant owner.

SSO-Bot: Alert created: INCIDENT-2026-03-20-SSO-KMS-ALG-MISMATCH. PagerDuty notified.

Arjun: Quick mitigation — add asymmetric alg translation in key resolver. Patch branch: fix/saml-kms-alg-fallback. I'll open PR and backport to 2.18.1 and 2.17.4.

Jess: For audit gap, the RBAC grant events have payload encrypted with key version v2; re-ingest fails because we used prior key. I can run re-decrypt job once we have key resolver updated.

Morgan: Customer-facing note draft: 'We're investigating SSO and provisioning errors after key rotation. Workaround: re-provision IdP cert or wait for a hotfix. ETA 2 hours.' Agree?

Nate: I'll post to customer slack and open a ticket. tagging @support-leads :white_check_mark: 

Riley: Locking change: don't auto-rotate KMS alias for Private tenants until resolver backfill complete. I'll add a flag.

SSO-Bot: Deployment scheduled: fix/saml-kms-alg-fallback -> canary at 17:10 UTC.

Arjun: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4321 (draft). Tests: added integration with mock-kms for RSA-OAEP-256.

Morgan: Thanks team. After hotfix, Jess run re-decrypt and validate audit records for 1h window. Close once customers confirm.

Jess: I'll run the re-decrypt job with `--tenant acme-corp --since 2026-03-20T15:50Z` and post results here.

Nate: Customer updated: they confirmed IdP cert unchanged; they did rotate keys via their KMS policy automation. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

Riley: Note for postmortem: record that KMS alg metadata must be included in idp_kms_mappings and in rollout checklist for Private.

Morgan: Marking follow-ups: PM for postmortem (Morgan), Security owner (Riley), Runtime patch (Arjun), Support comms (Nate). We'll reconvene after canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
